about: The agent's check of each figure record against its maker's document, 2026-09-25 (brain/decisions.md [2026-09-25]). Evidence, not verification: an agent's check never makes a figure trusted. scripts/verify_figures.py --review shows it beside each record; --confirm-agreeing records a person's verification of the ones that agree, bound to the same record hash. A record edited since its check has stale evidence and must be checked again.
checked_by: the agent (an LLM, claude-opus-5-5), 2026-09-25; rechecked 2026-09-30 by four independent agents told to refute it (workflow d7-adversarial-recheck) — 11 refuted and corrected; the MAX485, MAX3485 and STM32F411 documents read 2026-10-02 — 2 corrected

verdicts.agrees: the document says what the record says (records it contradicted were corrected first)
verdicts.agrees_in_part: what the document covers agrees; the rest is in a document that was not read
verdicts.not_checked: the document could not be obtained or found
